observation.visible_scene: A close-up view of a lit lantern with a glass chimney, emitting a bright, overexposed flame. To the right sits a red lantern with a handle. The background is dimly lit, showing horizontal white tubes and a wooden surface.

The camera moves slightly, causing shifts in perspective and framing, making the lanterns appear to move relative to the background.
The brightness of the flame fluctuates, causing changes in the glare on the glass chimney.
outside_clip_unknowns: The full layout of the room.
The fuel source of the lantern.
The purpose of the lighting setup.
uncertain_details: The exact type of the red object on the right (likely a lantern).
The material of the white tubes in the background.
